concepts.name: Fraction basics (part-whole, number line)
concepts.description: Foundational baseline: part-whole relationships, unit fractions, and number line representations.

concepts.name: Equivalent fractions and simplifying
concepts.description: Equivalence principle: generating equivalent fractions and reducing to lowest terms via GCD.

concepts.name: Comparing and ordering fractions
concepts.description: Magnitude comparison using benchmark fractions (0, 1/2, 1) and common denominators.

concepts.name: Adding and subtracting fractions
concepts.description: Fraction addition and subtraction across like and unlike denominators using LCD.

concepts.name: Multiplying and dividing fractions
concepts.description: Multiplicative operations: area scaling, cross-simplification, and reciprocal division.

concepts.name: Ratio basics (part:part, part:whole)
concepts.description: Relational thinking: understanding part-to-part and part-to-whole ratios.

concepts.name: Equivalent ratios and unit rate
concepts.description: Rate of change: finding unit rates, scaling ratios, and identifying proportional tables.

concepts.name: Proportion (solve a/b = c/d)
concepts.description: Algebraic scaling: solving proportions using cross-multiplication and constant of proportionality.

concepts.name: Percentages as ratios
concepts.description: Per-hundred representation: converting between fractions, decimals, and percentages.

concepts.name: Proportion word problems & scaling
concepts.description: Capstone node: multi-step real-world modeling, map scales, currency conversions, and rate synthesis.
